name_input: THE KERALA MINERALS AND METALS LTD; THE KERALA MINERALS AND METALS LIMITED; KMML
legal_name: The Kerala Minerals and Metals Limited
note: Legal entity confirmed as existing and active: official corporate website kmml.com (fetched) identifies 'The Kerala Minerals & Metals Limited (A Government of Kerala Undertaking)', registered office Sankaramangalam, Chavara, Kollam, Kerala 691583, tel +91 476 2651215. Role = manufacturer: own integrated titanium dioxide facility with mining, mineral separation, synthetic rutile and pigment plants, brand KEMOX (kmml.com/about-kmml). Declared HS 282300 (titanium oxides) is consistent with actual product (TiO2 pigment); 320611 (pigments with >=80% TiO2) also consistent; 282739 is a generic chlorides heading and is not evidenced by the site's product list - HS code should be corrected to the factual product codes (282300 / 320611), not a rejection ground. CIN, PAN, GSTIN, incorporation date, MCA status and audited FY25/FY26 revenue could NOT be verified: DuckDuckGo search tool was down (connection refused) throughout, and registry aggregators returned 403/404 (zaubacorp 403, thecompanycheck 403, instafinancials generic page only, tofler/quickcompany 404). The company's own Financials page (kmml.com/financials) lists annual reports only up to 2022-23 and the 'Ten Years Financial Highlights' link returned 404, so no FY25/FY26 audited figures are public there. Per rules, revenue left null rather than estimated. No ground for rejection: entity exists and is not struck off/liquidated per its live official site; MCA status unverified due to tool failure, not adverse.
